# NEW 2026-11-25 v26.0 WP7-1 Batch 1: Consolidated BYZ-only monthly_country_pulse bundle.
# Generated by gen_v260_pulse_consolidation.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Merges 10 independent pure tag=BYZ monthly pulses (zero behavior change; single outer tag=BYZ check).

monthly_country_pulse = {
    on_actions = { oe_v260_byz_monthly_bundle }
}

oe_v260_byz_monthly_bundle = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        tag = BYZ
        is_rebel_country = no
    }
    effect = {
        # 1. oe_athens_administration (direct reference to one location)
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_athens_administration_available = yes
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_athens_administration_pending }
            }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_athens_administration.1
        }

        # 2. oe_egypt_supply (deferred to following day)
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_works_egypt_supply_unlocked }
            trigger_event_silently = { id = oe_egypt_supply.1 days = 1 }
        }

        # 3. oe_hetaireia_infantry (indexed unit counter reconcile)
        if = {
            limit = { oe_hi_total_count > oe_hi_current_count }
            oe_hi_refresh = yes
        }

        # 4. oe_hetaireia_pronoia (indexed cavalry reconcile)
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_rum_pronoia_enacted
                oe_hetaireia_cavalry_normal_count > 0
            }
            oe_hetaireia_pronoia_upgrade = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_rum_pronoia_enacted }
                oe_hetaireia_cavalry_pronoia_count > 0
            }
            oe_hetaireia_pronoia_downgrade = yes
        }

        # 5. oe_m5_merit (authority from good government)
        oe_m5_monthly = yes

        # 6. oe_m9_outlets (outlets for legitimacy and public opinion)
        oe_m9_monthly = yes

        # 7. oe_roman_siegers (indexed artillery reconcile)
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_ir_artillery_done
                oe_roman_sieger_normal_count > 0
            }
            oe_roman_siegers_convert = { FORM = imperial }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_artillery_done }
                oe_roman_sieger_imperial_count > 0
            }
            oe_roman_siegers_convert = { FORM = normal }
        }

        # 8. oe_s37_gal_chain (1337 Galata chain)
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata
                    has_country_modifier = oe_s37_gal_curbed
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = oe_s37_gal_started
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_done }
                    }
                }
            }
            oe_s37_gal_monthly = yes
        }

        # 9. oe_tmc_theme_muster (conquest campaign theme muster)
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_tmc_on
                has_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
            }
            oe_tmc_monthly = yes
        }

        # 10. oe_tnh_houses (provincialisation former royal houses guard)
        oe_tnh_gov_monthly = yes
    }
}
